caption: The drawing features a composition on a vertically oriented, wooden surface divided into four planks. The primary color palette consists of shades of muted green applied onto a brown background, characteristic of wood grain. At the top of the drawing, there is a repeating pattern of overlapping, scalloped, semi-circular shapes in green, reminiscent of fish scales or stylized waves. Below this border, centrally positioned, is a large circular motif comprising a solid green center surrounded by a swirling, pinwheel-like design with multiple radial, curved segments, also in green, bordered by outward-pointing leaf or petal-like forms. Other elements include smaller, irregular green spots and shapes distributed unevenly throughout the lower and right portions of the drawing, as well as partial circular motifs visible on the far left and right edges that mirror the central motif. The overall surface has visible vertical lines corresponding to the separations between the wooden planks.
title: Stencilled Floor
